why: The flag parses, the registry documents it, the stylesheet carries every alternative -- and nothing applies it, so every one of them renders as the shipped transition. The failure is entirely silent: `parseDevFlags` still returns the value, `devControls()` still offers it, the generated doc still lists it, and anyone selecting `fade` to check whether the new default caused a report sees the new default and concludes it did not. That is the same class of defect #497 records for `ring+audio`, where a cue reached the parser as a different string and was read as a broken cue. Scoped to menu-transition.test.ts, where every alternative is read off the mounted stylesheet rather than off the option.
